biotools.summary: Scigantic is a cloud platform for scientific data discovery and exploratory analysis. Researchers can search and browse petabyte-scale public datasets, including genomics resources such as the 1000 Genomes data, bring and compare their own data, and carry out interactive analyses in AI-assisted computational notebooks that run next to the data across AWS, GCP, Azure and Hugging Face. The co-located compute model avoids moving large datasets for analysis.
biotools.name: Scigantic
